bengal.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Image 1 is the exact monument design reference MUSULMAN 4, image 2 is only the BENGAL stone reference. Create its clean frontal catalogue master in Bengal granite. Preserve all structural components and proportions: long wide thin rectangular base; raised open rectangular grave frame; two thick side rails with smoothly rounded front ends; lower front crossbar and recessed front ledge; rear transverse steps; tall upright headstone with straight lower sides, angular shoulders and pointed bulbous arch at the top. Keep the central cavity OPEN with its natural brown and grey gravel infill. All cut stone parts use image 2's polished black Bengal granite and fine silver crystalline grains. Remove optional surface decoration, including the mosque skyline, crescent and pale etched sky panel, leaving a plain undecorated stone face; preserve the complete outer headstone shape. No added parts, flowers, vases or text. Camera exactly centered on longitudinal axis, no left/right yaw, front headstone face parallel to image plane. Use near-orthographic projection with a modest elevation only to reveal frame and gravel, not a three-quarter view. Entire object visible with balanced margins. Uniform pale grey studio background, soft contact shadow, gentle light, no glare hiding stone. Single square image requested 2048x2048. This is the fixed geometry master for nine subsequent material-only edits.
bengal.controleVisuel: Source et resultat compares visuellement : cadre ouvert avec gravier, deux rails aux bouts avant arrondis, traverse et marche avant, marches arriere et silhouette ogivale conserves. Motif mosquee et champ clair retires comme decor optionnel, interpretation consignee. Vue axiale, perspective residuelle. Pilote non calibre.
